| [CASE-053](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-053.md) | Contextuality tests on human meaning and judgement data: a held null, and positive results that miss pragmatic content or power | The published tests of contextuality proper on elicited human judgements, read together. The null that meets every condition is the record's own [LIT-264](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-264.md): attitudinal and lexical data, none contextual under Contextuality-by-Default. Wang's thesis adds a Bell-type null on meaning judgements. The positive results miss a condition: Cervantes and Dzhafarov's "Snow Queen" is contextual with high reliability but its content is instructed attribute matching, and Lo, Sadrzadeh and Mansfield's Winograd schemas have the right content but a violation of about one standard deviation. No contextual pragmatic data are documented; "none in behavioural data" is too broad. | Active |
| [CASE-068](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-068.md) | Risk messages passed down diffusion chains: the evaluative signal kept and amplified while the content decays (Moussaïd, Brighton and Gaissmaier; Jagiello and Hills) | In two serial-reproduction experiments on risk messages, each link's message was coded for content and, on a separate scheme, for the evaluative stance of its statements toward the hazard. | [CASE-094](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-094.md) | The LEGO bin: a brick owned in one copy and buried among hundreds of similar ones may as well not be owned, a black brick among white ones needs no bin of its own, and every brick can be found by going through the whole collection | The owner's own parable, told on 2026-07-02 and kept verbatim in Mathematics of Meaning, where the owner paired it with the EMT case this record holds as [CASE-085](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-085.md). | [CASE-106](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-106.md) | The two-hypothesis linearization with endorsement scored on committed predictions: when the shared meaning bends the specialists' predictions with weight κ and the reading of the evidence with weight κ′, the coupling of interpretation to endorsement is γ = 4ηs(κ′ − κ̄) | Built for [QUESTION-121](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-121.md)'s formal question: is scoring operators on predictions committed before the evidence equivalent to Regime B? The construction keeps [CASE-099](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-099.md)'s two-hypothesis linearization and replaces the score with squared error between each specialist's committed prediction and the evidence as read. The coupling γ then has the sign of κ′ − κ̄: corrective when the interpretation bends the predictions more than the reading of the evidence, null when equally, capturing when less. Checked symbolically, and the stability conditions against 200,000 random draws. Fictional by construction. | Active |
| [CASE-107](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-107.md) | Locked-in syndrome: consciousness preserved with anarthria and quadriplegia; in the classic form, vertical eye movement and blinking remain and carry communication, and in the completely locked-in state no motor channel remains | The owner's case, U2 of the exchange of 2026-10-16: "a lucid human who struggles with locked-in syndrome". It separates lucid judgement from limb and speech action. In the classic form it does not separate judgement from action as active inference defines it, since the eye movements it spares are that theory's model action. The completely locked-in state is the real test, and there any evidence of lucidity has to come through a channel that is itself an action. Visceromotor regulation and Damasio's internal "as if body loop" survive paralysis, so the case never removes every contingency between intention and outcome. | Active |
